```{r}
#| include: false
if (!exists("CAP", inherits = FALSE)) CAP <- readCaption("fig.AEPS")
SiteID.caption <- .requireOneTarget(
  .currentTarget("siteID.target"), "siteID.target", "AEPS caption"
)
if (!exists("Vs30.target") || !length(Vs30.target)) {
  Vs30.target <- .resolveValueTarget(sort(unique(AEPSTable$Vs30)), "Vs30.target", "AEPS.qmd")
}
Target <- .currentTarget("ID.target")
ID.target <- .resolveIDTarget(
  AEPSTable,
  "AEPS.qmd",
  target = Target,
  siteID = .currentTarget("siteID.target"),
  base = TRUE
)
Sa.log <- TRUE
AEP.log <- TRUE
```
